summary: Cobra Muay Thai is a Muay Thai and boxing gym near Kata Beach, Phuket, with group classes, private sessions and on-site resort stays.

facts.label: Group classes
facts.value: Group Muay Thai Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM
facts.quote: Group Muay Thai Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM

facts.quote: Small classes with Thai coaches who know the pads

facts.quote: Cobra sits inside Chalong Chalet Resort.
